Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

- (a) If the Grade Pay of the Officer in the parent cadre becomes higher than that of the deputation post after getting proforma promotion, he may be allowed the pay in the Pay Band plus Grade Pay of the post to which he is promoted, if he so opts. In such cases, extensions in deputation after an employee has received the pro forma promotion may be considered as per the instructions contained in Paras. 8.1 to 8.3.2 of OM, dated 17-6-2010.
- GIO (1), Section I, Appendix 5.
